public_body: Southfield Redevelopment Authority Board Of Directors
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the claim that the Board's abbreviated executive session minutes were insufficiently detailed, because full released minutes met the standard. It separately noted, unprompted, a late response to a minutes request and only reminded the Board of its obligations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's abbreviated executive session minutes (placeholder blurbs) were insufficiently detailed to meet the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Board has provided us with the approved, released minutes of executive sessions held on November 14, 2016 and several other dates, and these minutes are sufficiently detailed to satisfy the Board’s obligations under the law.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the AG noted the Board did not provide requested November 16, 2014 executive session minutes, which were already released, within ten days.
allegations.key_passage: Because the November 16, 2014 executive session minutes had been released at the time they were requested, they should have been provided to the complainant within ten days.
